lines.text: You showed Uncle Sirisena the notice board. The real deadline. The laminated notice with the proper stamp.

lines.speaker: Uncle Sirisena
lines.text: Week 4? But Jayantha said — ah. Well. Perhaps Jayantha was confused. He is often confused about these things. I will send a correction.

He typed a message to Alupotha Patriots: 'CORRECTION — I got it wrong. Deadline is Week 4, not this week. Sorry for confusion.' Three seconds later he forwarded a joke video. Life in the group continues.
